items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And it looks like Rodas there. That's Joe Rodas there. ... [INTERVIEWEE] No, well, this is not a band.

ctx.x: That's right. Yeah, and then Pat Cook on bass, and what's the name, Charlie, what's the drummer? Charlie Duke. Yeah, Charlie Duke, yeah.
And it looks like Rodas there. That's Joe Rodas there. Well, you didn't have darts that day.
No, well, this is not a band. Oh, yeah. So I left the, the, the, the, the, the, the dream man went away with farts, you. Hmm.
